newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS reaffirms Avenor, downgrades Repap.
newsitem.headline: CBRS reaffirms Avenor, downgrades Repap.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Thursday it reaffirmed the ratings of Avenor Inc and downgraded the ratings of Repap Enterprises Inc following Avenor's failure to win shareholder approval for its proposed C$2.6 billion acquisition of Repap.
CBRS reaffirmed Avenor's debentures and senior notes at B+ (High) and convertible subordinated debentures at B (High).

The ratings of Repap's convertible debentures and Repap New Brunswick Inc's first-priority and second-priority secured notes were downgraded to C, and remain on CBRS's credit watch list with negative implications, CBRS said.
Repap's convertible debentures, first priority senior secured notes and second priority senior secured notes were previously rated at B (Low), B (High) and B, respectively.

"The ratings of Repap and its subsidiaries have remained in the speculative range through the 1990s as soaring debt levels and volatile market conditions contributed to large and persistent losses which eroded liquidity while increasing leverage to near intolerable levels," CBRS said.
It said the write-off in March of Repap British Columbia Inc is seen as a further signal of the company's inability to support and fund its asset base.
"As such, the current ratings reflect the highly speculative credit quality of Repap's outstanding securities and its highly diminished level of liquidity and capital support," CBRS said.
